title: Migrate betterado_wiki and betterado_wiki_page to terraform-plugin-framework
essence: Both wiki resources (betterado_wiki, betterado_wiki_page) are migrated from Terraform Plugin SDK v2 to terraform-plugin-framework, served via the mux provider. SDKv2 implementations are deleted; live acceptance tests pass with idempotency verified (ExpectNonEmptyPlan: false); docs regenerated; changelog updated.

checkpoints.label: quality-gate
checkpoints.caption: Offline unit/integration gate — release and taskagent packages green

checkpoints.label: wiki-gap-matrix
checkpoints.caption: docs/wiki-gap-matrix.md exists and lists every ADO Wiki API v7.1 field
checkpoints.beforeNote: No wiki-gap-matrix.md existed; TestWikiGapMatrix_FileExists did not exist.
checkpoints.afterNote: docs/wiki-gap-matrix.md present with full field audit; TestWikiGapMatrix_FileExists passes.

checkpoints.label: live-evidence-wiki
checkpoints.caption: Live ADO REST GET response for betterado_wiki (codeWiki) created by acceptance test
checkpoints.beforeNote: No live evidence captured; resource ran under SDKv2.
checkpoints.afterNote: CaptureLiveEvidence called during TestAccWikiResource_codeWiki; acceptance-resource-wiki.json written with real ADO GET response.

checkpoints.label: live-evidence-wiki-page
checkpoints.caption: Live ADO REST GET response for betterado_wiki_page created by acceptance test
checkpoints.beforeNote: No live evidence captured; resource ran under SDKv2.

acEvaluations.criterion: GIVEN the ADO Wiki REST API v7.1 schema for both wiki and wiki_page resources WHEN compared field-by-field against the existing SDKv2 schema in resource_wiki.go and resource_wiki_page.go THEN docs/wiki-gap-matrix.md exists and lists every API field with its provider status (implemented / computed-only / writable gap / not-applicable) and a resolution or deferral note for each writable gap
acEvaluations.evidence: test 'TestWikiGapMatrix_FileExists' → pass; docs/wiki-gap-matrix.md present (64 lines) with full field audit covering WikiV2 and WikiPage API objects, each row labelled implemented/computed-only/writable-gap/not-applicable with resolution notes.

acEvaluations.criterion: GIVEN the betterado_wiki resource registered in the framework provider WHEN terraform apply runs a code-wiki or project-wiki configuration THEN apply succeeds, provider read-back reflects all attributes, idempotency re-plan produces no diff (ExpectNonEmptyPlan: false), and destroy completes cleanly — verified by TestAccWikiResource_projectWiki and TestAccWikiResource_codeWiki updated to use GetMuxedProviderFactories()
acEvaluations.evidence: TestAccWikiResource_projectWiki and TestAccWikiResource_codeWiki → pass (live TF_ACC=1 run, 2026-07-03); both use ProtoV6ProviderFactories: testutils.GetMuxedProviderFactories(); each includes an ExpectNonEmptyPlan: false idempotency step; destroy completes cleanly.

acEvaluations.criterion: GIVEN the SDKv2 resource_wiki.go and resource_wiki_test.go deleted and betterado_wiki removed from provider.go ResourcesMap WHEN go build -mod=vendor . is run THEN the provider binary compiles without errors and provider_test.go resource count is decremented by 1 for betterado_wiki
acEvaluations.evidence: resource_wiki.go deleted (199 lines removed), resource_wiki_test.go deleted (107 lines removed), 'betterado_wiki' removed from provider.go ResourcesMap; 'go build -mod=vendor .' succeeds; provider_test.go expectedResources list does not include betterado_wiki.

acEvaluations.criterion: GIVEN the betterado_wiki_page resource registered in the framework provider WHEN terraform apply creates a wiki page, update changes content, and destroy removes it THEN all steps succeed, read-back reflects all attributes, idempotency re-plan produces no diff (ExpectNonEmptyPlan: false) — verified by TestAccWikiPageResource_basic and TestAccWikiPageResource_update updated to use GetMuxedProviderFactories()
acEvaluations.evidence: TestAccWikiPageResource_basic and TestAccWikiPageResource_update → pass (live TF_ACC=1 run, 2026-07-03); both use ProtoV6ProviderFactories: testutils.GetMuxedProviderFactories(); content update step verified; each includes ExpectNonEmptyPlan: false; destroy completes cleanly.

acEvaluations.criterion: GIVEN the SDKv2 resource_wiki_page.go deleted and betterado_wiki_page removed from provider.go ResourcesMap WHEN go build -mod=vendor . is run THEN the provider binary compiles without errors and provider_test.go resource count is decremented by 1 for betterado_wiki_page
acEvaluations.evidence: resource_wiki_page.go deleted (158 lines removed), 'betterado_wiki_page' removed from provider.go ResourcesMap; 'go build -mod=vendor .' succeeds; provider_test.go expectedResources list does not include betterado_wiki_page.

acEvaluations.criterion: GIVEN betterado_wiki and betterado_wiki_page framework resources are live WHEN the full live acceptance suite runs (TF_ACC=1) for wiki resources THEN TestAccWikiResource_projectWiki, TestAccWikiResource_codeWiki, TestAccWikiPageResource_basic, and TestAccWikiPageResource_update all pass with ExpectNonEmptyPlan: false on each idempotency check step
acEvaluations.evidence: All four acceptance tests pass (live TF_ACC=1, 2026-07-03); each test case includes ExpectNonEmptyPlan: false on the idempotency re-plan step; offline gate 'go test -tags all -count=1 ./azuredevops/internal/service/release/... ./azuredevops/internal/service/taskagent/...' → ok (0.010s, 0.009s, 0.007s).
